11159.title: Secrets & Lies
11159.overview: After her adoptive mother dies, Hortense, a successful black optometrist, seeks out her birth mother. She's shocked when her research leads her to Cynthia, a working class white woman.

15575.title: Bleach the Movie: Memories of Nobody
15575.overview: In Karakura Town, unidentifiable spirits begin appearing en mases. While attempting to deal with these strange souls, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Senna, a mysterious shinigami who wipes out most of them. Senna refuses to answer any questions, so Ichigo is forced to follow her while Rukia tries to find out what's going on.
15575.original_title: 劇場版 BLEACH MEMORIES OF NOBODY

31767.title: The Devils
31767.overview: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of a sexually obsessed nun’s witchcraft accusations, which corrupt church and state officials are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

91735.title: My Brother's Wedding
91735.overview: A young African-American man, living in Los Angeles without direction in his life, reluctantly agrees to be the best man for his brother, an upwardly mobile lawyer.

199511.title: Caiçara
199511.overview: Marina, a beautiful young woman with leprous parents, marries a shipyard owner to escape an institution. She moves to a coastal village, faces gossip, and is assaulted by her husband’s partner. After her husband dies in a boat accident, a handsome sailor arrives, and Marina is blackmailed about her family’s health issues.

204119.title: Linna
204119.overview: Based on Franz Kafka's famous novel, director Jaakko Pakkasvirta created this interpretation of the woebegone Josef K., who is trapped in an ever-increasing labyrinth of double talk and bureaucratic nonsense in his efforts to reach the castle. As Josef seeks to make an appointment to see the ruler Herr Klamm inside his inaccessible abode, he becomes enmeshed in abuse from lowly villagers and bureaucrats alike. His endless false starts toward the castle's enigmatic interior are partly offset by a few sexual encounters but nothing alleviates his role as a victim of forces beyond his control.

277015.title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
277015.overview: Follows hospital workers who keep 400 people alive inside Cama Hospital while armed assailants strike the city during terror attacks in India.

964311.title: Vinski 2
964311.overview: The town of Hömpstad is once again under threat from criminals and Vinski's help is needed. When the criminals manage to steal the invisibility powder for themselves, Vinski has a real showdown on his hands.

1113623.title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
1113623.overview: Serving as an intimate and cinematic portrait of Sagan, the Untitled Carl Sagan Documentary will explore his love story with partner Ann Druyan and with science. The film will include exclusive audio recordings, archival clips and animation, along with interviews with his family, friends and colleagues. With the full support of Sagan’s family and friends, the film will present a fascinating look into the life and career of one of the world’s most inspiring and revolutionizing scientists of our time.

1118231.title: HOPING FOR FREEDOM
1118231.overview: Anger, bullets and blood were the only things they gave us.  Suffocation.  Fight, fight, fight!  Cruelty in the world will not last and finally one day the sun will rise and the darkness will disappear.

1159255.title: F.L.Y.
1159255.overview: F.L.Y. is a funny slice-of-life movie about Max and Rafael, former partners, forced to quarantine together during the COVID pandemic. They haven't seen each other in five years, and now Rafael has a new boyfriend. With the added twist of Rafael pursuing a dream of becoming a drag superstar in LA, their reunion gets off to a bumpy start.

1159831.title: The Bride!
1159831.overview: A lonely Frankenstein travels to 1930s Chicago to ask groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious to create a companion for him. The two revive a murdered young woman and The Bride is born. But what ensues is beyond what either of them imagined.

1182935.title: The Unknown
1182935.overview: Photographer David Zimmerman rarely leaves home until friends bring him to a wild party. He becomes fixated on a mysterious woman and follows her. By dawn, his life transforms - he awakens in her body.

1206167.title: Return of the Jungle
1206167.overview: Nine year old Mihir and his friends are faced with the daunting task of outwitting the biggest, meanest bully in school, Rahul Malhotra. To help them ride through this impossible journey, they turn to Thatha and his fantastic tales of inspiration from the ancient Jungles of India. Together, they must build a ruthless dinosaur, fight a nerve- racking game of cricket and travel all the way to Rajasthan, to rediscover the power of friendship, compassion and determination.
1206167.trailerName: RETURN OF THE JUNGLE | Official Teaser | Releasing May 29

1258967.title: The Myth of Maracuda 2: Sugar Age

1269399.title: Holy Meat
1269399.overview: Father Iversen has a mission: to save his parish. He already has an idea. With a spectacular performance of the Passion story, he wants to convince the theater-loving archbishop to keep the parish. But director Roberto, who has been canceled by the Berlin theater scene, and Mia, the butcher who has returned involuntarily, thwart his plans.

1292695.title: They Will Kill You
1292695.overview: A woman answers a help wanted ad to be a housekeeper in a mysterious New York City high-rise, unaware that she is entering a community that has seen a number of disappearances over the years and may be under the grip of a Satanic cult.

1299799.title: Chopin, a Sonata in Paris
1299799.overview: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.

1327447.title: Vanilla
1327447.overview: In the late 80s Mexico, a family made up of seven women from different generations and ideologies fights to save the house in which they live and which they are about to lose due to an outstanding debt. We see the story through the eyes of the youngest, Roberta (8), as she embarks on a journey of self-discovery, which impacts the rest of the family.

1336855.title: The Basics of Philosophy
1336855.overview: A repressed philosophy professor, Dr. John Jorissen, is employed at Ridgemont College, a small liberal arts school in the American Midwest. He teaches an introductory course and is writing a book on renowned Dutch philosopher Baruch Spinoza. Haunted by a long-buried transgression and the sudden return of its victim, he descends into a crisis of guilt, desire, and spiritual reckoning.

1358167.title: Where Souls Go
1358167.overview: Eighteen-year-old Anna has been diagnosed with an incurable terminal illness and has chosen to end her life on her own terms. With only fifteen days remaining, her final wish is to reconnect with her older half-sisters, Ève and Éléonore, from whom she has been estranged ever since their father went to prison. The three sisters must confront their painful past and rediscover the bond of sisterhood before time runs out.
1358167.trailerName: Où vont les âmes | Un film de Brigitte Poupart | Au cinéma le 14 novembre

1368535.title: Measure in Love
1368535.overview: In a world split by a gravity wall where time moves differently, a woman from the Aurora Zone and a man from the Evergreen Zone fall in love, despite the impossible challenge that one day for her equals one year for him.
1368535.trailerName: 他年她日 ｜ Measure In Love | Main Trailer | 首支预告片

1376279.title: Aloha, Malandro!
1376279.overview: Broke and daydreaming about Hawaii, Jairo envisions an easy life without hard work. His chance comes when his depressed half-brother, Barãozinho, gets involved with the sister of an art smuggler. Jairo sees the perfect opportunity to steal from the guy and make his dream a reality. But he didn’t plan on falling in love—or accidentally getting tangled up in a string of murders, turning his dream scheme into a full-blown nightmare.

1398487.title: The Saviors
1398487.overview: A suburban couple whose life spirals out of control when they rent their garage to mysterious tenants.

1400791.title: Coexistence, My Ass!
1400791.overview: Noam Shuster Eliassi grew up the literal poster child for the Israeli-Palestinian peace process before making a hard pivot to stand-up comedy and political satire. But as the region sinks deeper into devastating violence, she must meet the moment by challenging her audiences with hard truths that are no laughing matter.

1418967.title: Televil
1418967.overview: Glah discovers an old TV in the storage room of his house. On the screen, 90s TV shows are being broadcast featuring four teens who went missing 35 years ago, crying out for help.
1418967.original_title: มันแอบในจอ

1423191.title: Resident Evil
1423191.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

1433367.title: One Night Only
1433367.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

1434583.title: The Remedy
1434583.overview: A troubled young man is the caregiver for both his terminally-ill mother and his mentally-ill sister. When he makes a desperate attempt to save his mom, he unleashes a supernatural entity that feeds on human flesh.

1437143.title: KJQ
1437143.overview: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.
1437143.trailerName: KJQ TRAILER | Dheekshith Shetty | Shashi Odela | Yukti Thareja | KK | SLV Cinemas | Aug 7th Release

1447447.title: Place to Be
1447447.overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

1465559.title: Anima
1465559.overview: A young woman and an old man embark on a road trip to preserve his consciousness at an experimental facility.

1465751.title: She Dances
1465751.overview: A father and his distant teenage daughter road-trip to a dance competition, confronting their shared grief over a family tragedy.

1465943.title: Mandaadi
1465943.overview: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.
1465943.trailerName: Mandaadi - Trailer (Tamil) | Soori | Suhas | Mahima Nambiar | GV Prakash | Mathimaran Pugazhendhi

1466007.title: Identitti
1466007.overview: A student named Nivedita finds an old photo of her professor and discovers the latter had been living a lie. Saraswati, of all people — a woman of color who lectures on cultural identity — is in fact white. While the media and online community whip up a frenzy, Nivedita faces a political and personal dilemma as she tries to find out Saraswati's motive.

1470039.title: Kochschule Schwarz
1470039.overview: Munich, 1938: After his traditional Jewish restaurant was destroyed by the Nazis during Kristallnacht, restaurateur Richard Schwarz and charismatic jack-of-all-trades Edgar Enders hatch a daring plan. They open a sophisticated Jewish cooking school.

1472919.title: Echo of Tomorrow's War
1472919.overview: The EU has fallen apart, and in Germany, far-right populists are forming a new government. War is imminent. Jonas has deserted; he and his sister go into hiding at the home of their father, Stuber, whom Jonas has not seen since childhood. But there, the situation escalates. A catastrophe occurs even before the war has begun.
1472919.trailerName: MORGEN WAR KRIEG | Trailer | Neues Deutsches Kino | FILMFEST MÜNCHEN 2026

1475799.title: Haiwaan
1475799.overview: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.
1475799.trailerName: Haiwaan - Official Trailer | Akshay Kumar, Saif Ali Khan, Boman, Shriya, Saiyami | Priyadarshan

1477719.title: Photograph 51
1477719.overview: Inspired by the true story of Rosalind Franklin, the groundbreaking British scientist who first unveiled the hidden structure of DNA but whose legacy has been overshadowed.

1480407.title: December
1480407.overview: Amid December’s festive glow, refugees remain hidden in forests along the Poland-Belarus border. This powerful documentary gives voice to their silent cries.

1488663.title: Blood Yolk
1488663.overview: After returning to her family’s decaying farm, an estranged writer confronts a dark secret that forces her to question her twin brother’s involvement in a string of murders — and her own capacity to kill.

1494231.title: La maleta
1494231.overview: Laura and Nacho meet on a flight, but their brief encounter ends when they pick up their bags. Laura proposes a game, revealing the suitcase belongs to terrorists.

1522071.title: Pray for Us
1522071.overview: In the mid-to-late 1970s, two young women from different social backgrounds meet inside the Patronato de Protección a la Mujer (Women’s Protection Board), a state-backed institution that confined thousands of women, many single mothers, in convents and boarding schools under the guise of moral 'reform'. Ana, a rebellious 19-year-old from Barcelona, is sent by her wealthy father to a Patronato facility overseen by the merciless Sister Socorro. Amid the harsh conditions, Ana forms a deep bond with Sole, a friendship tested by escape attempts, reprisals, and an ultimate sacrifice.
1522071.trailerName: Pray for Us, by Daniel Monzón | Teaser | In theaters November 6, 2026

1543767.title: Love Untamed
1543767.overview: Bjørn (16) has a special and unconventional bond with his circus dog, Freja. When his family discovers their secret relationship, they separate them, leaving Bjørn filled with shame and confusion. As he attempts to behave like a typical 16-year-old boy, he confronts profound questions about love, acceptance, and how we treat and coexist with our animals.

1547671.title: DETAIL THE HUMAN OPERA
1547671.overview: Ramiel is on the subway with his girlfriend when he sees someone from his past on an adjacent running train. He decides to get some closure.

1548183.title: A Window of Memories
1548183.overview: The filmmaker’s own paternal and maternal grandmothers’ stories are compiled into texts and read aloud by two women. This film ventures to convey the memories of two grandmothers from two different families, through the bodies of others.
1548183.trailerName: A Window of Memories -YIDFF 2025 International Competition Trailer

1549719.title: I Will Come
1549719.overview: Sixteen-year-old Timofey, who foolishly ended up in a juvenile detention center, escapes during an off-site concert to find his gravely ill grandmother—the only family he has—who hasn't responded to his letters for two months. Following him is an eight-year-old street kid, Malek, who uncontrollably creates only difficulties along the way. The detention center's management conceals the escape and conducts their own pursuit of the runaways. The journey home in search of Timofey’s grandmother turns into a trial for both boys, helping them understand the true meaning of friendship, honesty, and justice.

1550039.title: Black Silk
1550039.overview: A sequel to the spy thriller Red Silk.

1552407.title: Drea & Cloe
1552407.overview: Two ambitious women, both orchestra conductors, meet in a gothic mansion and are instantly drawn to each other. But their attraction is complicated when they discover they’re rivals for the same prestigious job.

1557399.title: together apart.
1557399.overview: Sophie and Jojo have been separated for six months but still live together like a couple. Only when Sophie's parents—who are unaware of the breakup—make their continued financial support conditional on her having a child with Jojo does movement come into the stagnant lives of the two millennials.

1559575.title: Kafir: Gerbang Sukma
1559575.overview: Eight years after Herman's tragic death due to black magic, Sri is rebuilding her life with her daughter, Dina, and Andi, who has married Rani. Sri's father informs her that her mother is seriously ill. They come to visit, and that's the beginning of their disaster. A past sin Sri has been hiding now threatens her family.

1560599.title: Vestige
1560599.overview: When a hooded figure steps into an abandoned house deep in the woods, flickering lights awaken memories of the family who once called it home.

1561687.title: Made in Korea
1561687.overview: A woman from a small town in Tamil Nadu moves to South Korea — a place she always dreamed of — but struggles to find her footing in a foreign land.

1563031.title: BETTER WITH MILK
1563031.overview: In 1947, in an upscale neighborhood of Brighton, Parvati has been working as a maid for Victoria since arriving from India six years earlier. Her encounter with Preethi, the neighbor's new maid, awakens buried memories, transporting her back to her native country despite herself.

1563543.title: The Good Daughter
1563543.overview: After her parents’ separation, Carmela and her mother move into her grandmother’s home. As Carmela struggles to adjust to her new reality, she longs to spend more time at her father’s place, a visual artist she both admires and idolizes. His presence looms over the three generations of women, pushing them to confront and decide the future they each deserve.

1569815.title: Volume 7
1569815.overview: The future is just another past. In an isolated City-Building marked 7, where human knowledge is preserved in the minds of the gifted and time moves in endless loops, a young man reappears again and again, confronting love, rebellion, and the elusive promise of escape. A woman, who meets him each time, becomes the mirror of this repetition, keeping alive the fragile hope that something might finally change.

1573783.title: The Wedding Entertainer (The Tale of Moishe Badhan)
1573783.overview: Jerusalem's greatest badchan (Hasidic wedding comedian), wrecked his career because of liquor and a big mouth, gets a second chance as the sidekick of the famous American Badchan Meshulam. At the wedding, everything spins out of control.

1579223.title: West by Northwest
1579223.overview: The film interweaves three RV travel stories across China, exploring themes of family connection, generational conflict, and finding closure among different age groups facing life's emotional and existential challenges.

1584215.title: The Internship
1584215.overview: A CIA-trained assassin recruits other graduates from her secret childhood program, The Internship, to violently destroy the organization. The CIA fights back with deadly force.

1584855.title: Paradise Lost
1584855.overview: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

1585239.title: Club Kid
1585239.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

1586199.title: The Man in the Second Story Window
1586199.overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

1587351.title: Canned Heat
1587351.overview: In the summer of 1987 in Rio de Janeiro, thousands of cans of marijuana mysteriously wash up on the city's beaches, sparking a scramble for this unexpected "green gold." To investigate the case, Detective Dantas pairs up two federal agents with opposing temperaments: Sandra, a street-smart cop with a gambling addiction, and Brasa, a stickler for protocol who has never made an arrest. Surrounded by drug traffickers, corrupt cops, journalists, and opportunists, the duo must overcome their differences before chaos engulfs the coast.

1588247.title: Совок
1588247.overview: Vyacheslav Ermakov, a phony businessman and life-waster, owes a large sum to a crime boss and, to pay off his debt, is forced to agree to carry out his errand. But a fateful encounter occurs along the way. To survive, Slava must play a survival game. The film is unusual in the ambiguity of its antagonist and his motives, all set against the backdrop of class conflict and reflection on the collapse of the USSR.

1588887.title: Batter Up, Queen!
1588887.overview: Drag queen Frannie P. Bodied takes on the most mortifying gig of her career: babysitting a bubbly child baseball player.

1589655.title: Shaka Oh Shaka
1589655.overview: A meeting at a concert changes everything. Ocel, a simple college student, never expected to become the lover of her idol, Shaka. Their closeness, which began with admiration, blossomed into a mutually reinforcing love. However, their relationship was tested by the realities of life and the swift currents of time. Will they survive, or will they find their way through separation?

1592087.title: Leo and Tig. The Road to Baikal
1592087.overview: Leo and Tig set off on a journey to faraway Lake Baikal to bring back home the lost seal pup named Lufi. Along the way, they make new friends with Zhu, a red panda, and Wukong the Monkey King. They also cross paths with the evil chieftain of a horse herd Tengri-Khan, who wants to seize the seal. For whoever brings Lufi home will be granted any wish by the Master of Baikal – the great dragon Lusud.

1592343.title: O Little Christmas Market
1592343.overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

1595223.title: 2DIE4
1595223.overview: The film follows Brazilian Formula 1 driver Felipe Nasr as he competes in a real race, capturing a story unfolding in real time.

1599191.title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer

1606423.title: Spirits Talk
1606423.overview: A grieving woman’s reality and memories begin to blur as her adoptive mother, Mother Nikki, reaches out to her from the spirit realm. She must speak to her mother one last time—or risk losing the ability to love herself and others.

1606615.title: Gordian Knot
1606615.overview: Keywan receives a call from a woman in Iran asking him to find her son Ashkan in Cologne, whom she hasn't reached for three days. Despite having minimal interaction with Ashkan, Keywan accepts the request.

1606871.title: Knock, Knock, Knock
1606871.overview: Three years after the Jamestown NightStalker murders in 2024 that killed both his brothers, Collin Woods lives in a state of confusion and paranoia. Seeing a psychiatrist and living with his best friend, his symptoms worsen when a reoccurring dream predicts the return of The NightStalker. As people around Collin begin to be killed, he is forced to confront his fate, or watch as The NightStalker takes the couple things he still has left.

1607127.title: One Last Shot
1607127.overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

1608727.title: Vintage Violence
1608727.overview: When a disgraced livestreamer discovers a trove of rare vintage denim in a Colorado mine, he follows it to Tokyo and straight into the arms of a woman who may be using him. Caught between desire and betrayal, he soon finds himself entangled in black-market turf wars, yakuza, and a past that refuses to stay buried.

1609495.title: Legendary Divine Kung Fu
1609495.overview: n the 1970s, Hong Yingzhen is born into the martial arts family of the Hong Blade Sect in the Chinatown of H Country. Yet despite his lineage, he grows up achieving nothing of note and is mockingly labeled a “good-for-nothing” by those around him.  By chance, Hong Yingzhen reunites with an old classmate, Bao Dian, and is introduced to Brother Bao, the leader of the Zhongxiao Hall, unwittingly becoming entangled in a dangerous conspiracy. Meanwhile, the reclusive martial arts master Wuchen sees through Hong Yingzhen’s mediocrity and recognizes him as a hidden prodigy. Wuchen unlocks his blocked meridians, setting his true potential free.

1611799.title: Fallen From Olympus
1611799.overview: Following the Trojan War, a soldier facing death encounters Thanatos and is drawn into a mythological confrontation about life, fate, and the meaninglessness of war.

1613335.title: Miracle: The Boys of '80
1613335.overview: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.

1614231.title: Seniors
1614231.overview: A high school senior goes on his first college campus tour the day his parents’ marriage begins to fracture.

1614487.title: The Alice Paradox
1614487.overview: Alice travels through a wormhole, and is transported into an alternate version of the recent past where she encounters different versions of herself and her friend and lab partner, Bob. Trapped in a world that has diverged from ours during the Cold War, and which prizes collectivism over individuality, Alice is forced to confront her life choices, grappling with profound questions about identity, fate, and the search for meaning.

1615767.title: Fury In the Shadows
1615767.overview: The story opens with a meticulously planned robbery of the "Harman Development Bank" (哈曼发展银行). Tan Li (Shi Yanneng), a ruthless bandit leader, orchestrates the heist with his crew members Han Qiliang and A Mu during a torrential downpour. The robbery quickly turns violent—they shoot and kill a patrol officer named Bowen, triggering an immediate police response.

1616215.title: Flag Day
1616215.overview: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

1617239.title: The Last Critic
1617239.overview: Sixty years & a million records ago, Robert Christgau invented Rock music criticism. Anyone who has ever read or written a Pop music review has been influenced by Christgau, who canonized legends from The Ramones to Public Enemy & infuriated icons from Lou Reed to Billy Joel. Now in his eighties, Bob is still at it—amazingly with the same vigor, wit, concision and craft that has defined his expansive career. But in a world where albums are irrelevant, where print is dead & where algorithms have eclipsed critics we are forced to ask: What happens next—for Bob, but also for all music criticism? Is this the end of something? Is Robert Christgau the last critic?

1620695.title: Ekshathe Alada
1620695.overview: When a couple realise their marriage is dead and mutually choose divorce, their families launch a relentless mission to keep them together—forcing them to fight not just for freedom, but for the radical idea that happiness matters more than a “perfect” marriage.

1621719.title: Starguy and I
1621719.overview: Awkward and reserved Omar spends his night helping an otherwordly creature find its way back home. In the process, he realizes just how alike they truly are.

1623255.title: Doppelgänger
1623255.overview: When ten-year old Josie Johns met her doppelgänger, it kicked off a decade of intense and bitter rivalry. Now an adult, Josie is about to confront her double, settle some scores, and take back control of her identity once and for all.

1624471.title: Finding Connection
1624471.overview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

1630423.title: My Dearest Assassin
1630423.overview: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

1631127.title: Shells: Shaped by Nature
1631127.overview: Since the dawn of time, Nature has sculpted the oceans with her delicate hand, weaving the tapestry of life in the shimmering depths and sunlit shallows. With infinite care, she conjured snails and mollusks to inhabit diverse marine realms around the African continent, each a reflection of her boundless creativity and wisdom. These delicate spirals, with their tender curves, ensnare our imagination, inspiring art, shaping cultures, adorning garments, and even serving as currency in ancient economies. "Shells: Shaped by Nature" is an artistic tribute to the enigmatic splendor of shells, celebrating these intricate marvels that grace Africa’s marine realms.

1632151.title: My First Love
1632151.overview: Young singer Paulinho goes viral online with an old song written for his first love, Nina. Upon seeing the video's success, Nina reappears with a proposal: Paulinho must perform "pagode" shows to save her father's failing bridal shop. In exchange, she promises to help him find a new girlfriend. He accepts the deal to hide the fact that he still has feelings for her, but their forced proximity reignites their old romance.

1638807.title: How They Really Are
1638807.overview: A boy named Tyler Ortin is struggling with lonlieness and the problem of his parents constant fighting when he becomes friends with a classmate Louey. Tyler helps his class get their grades back on track but the stress catches up to him.

1648663.title: Candidates of Death
1648663.overview: A father goes on holiday with his son and two of his friends, during which time they make an amateur horror film together. As the years pass, they continue to shoot scenes for their “handcrafted,” carefree, imaginative horror project, with even more passion, dutiful consistency, and unwavering commitment: the documentary chronicles a decade of this beautiful adventure, as Maciej and the kids become a group of people who grow up… and yet somehow still manage to grow younger together.

1650007.title: Fishbrain
1650007.overview: Desperate to escape her decaying coastal town but unable to abandon the grandfather who depends on her, Ori sees a way out when tainted fish wash ashore, but only if she can bring herself to put them on his plate.

1659351.title: The Caretaker
1659351.overview: After a car accident leaves Miles paralyzed, his wife hires a live-in caretaker who will stop at nothing to become the man of the house.

1674327.title: NEOT: The Movie
1674327.overview: The long-awaited finale to NEOT! Will the cast finally make a funny joke? Will Mappy return again? And will the sloppily constructed lore finally coalesce into something somewhat coherent? There's only one way to find out!

1678231.title: Paradise
1678231.overview: Suleyman returns home after serving seven years, only to find his apartment block has been seized by drug dealers. When drawn into the violence surrounding the complex, his sole focus becomes keeping his mother safe.

1680087.title: Popeye 4 : Resurrection
1680087.overview: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.

1680407.title: Team JuL
1680407.overview: Jul, a true rap phenomenon, has become in just a few years the new face of Marseille. A kid from the working-class neighborhoods who, with a €20 microphone and a bedroom turned into a studio, reshaped French rap. Independent and hyper-productive, he imposes his own style and brings together all generations. Behind the auto-tune and Kalenji tracksuits lies a cultural revolution that is disrupting the established rules of the entertainment industry and extending far beyond the city of Marseille.

1686999.title: Enna Vilai
1686999.overview: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

1688279.title: The Nameless Season
1688279.overview: Do-wan grows increasingly anxious, afraid that he and Jae-yul, the boy he has secretly loved for years, will drift apart after graduation. After years apart, the two meet again by chance, and Do-wan realizes that the moment has come to finally confront his feelings.

1688855.title: Tornar-se Ciborgue no Interior
1688855.overview: Leo and Julia, owners of a rural property, want to have children but are facing fertility issues. Ava and Mia, a lesbian couple, have just moved to the neighboring property. The arrival of the two women will create tension with the neighbors.

1690583.title: Colon Parenthesis
1690583.overview: After an unconventional biomechanical system begins to experiance technical difficulties, its equally mechanical engineer opts for an unconventional solution to save the day.

1695639.title: THE 8LOCK
1695639.overview: Non, a young boy with a talent for writing rap lyrics, dreams of becoming a rapper to support himself and his family. But being born with a stutter turns the very thing he loves most into the hardest thing for him to express.  When he gets the chance to perform on a real rap stage for the first time, Non must face both the judgment of others and the fear of failure that has trapped him for years.  THE 8LOCK is the story of an ordinary kid trying to prove that even if he stumbles, speaks imperfectly, or falls again and again, he still has the right to dream and the courage to chase it.

1696151.title: Strong
1696151.overview: Lami Sawa, a radiant spiritual mentor and accomplished architect, appears to live an idyllic life with her devoted husband, Sota. Rooted in love and faith, their marriage is shattered when Sota is accused of infidelity and the murder of a woman, plunging Lami into doubt, scandal, and a fight for truth.

1698647.title: A Walk
1698647.overview: A man goes for a walk that gradually becomes more glitchy.

1699863.title: Nine Counties
1699863.overview: The Winter Solstice as seen through the lens of a Super 8 road movie; a vignette painted through impressions of the land, the sights, the sounds and the local radio stations.

1699991.title: Clay
1699991.overview: Emerging from a plaster egg in Central Park, a baby embarks on a lyrical voyage through the city’s pulse, uncovering her true form.

1700567.title: Burrow
1700567.overview: A year after the death of her brother, a young woman joins her friends on a drug-infused getaway that spirals into a night of horror when an alien insect burrows into one of her friends, transforming him into a vicious man-eating creature.

1700695.title: Frankie the Rabbit’s Final Preparations
1700695.overview: Franio the rabbit has been preparing for a long time for the day that is set to change everything. A lamp, stool and a new rope – every item is already in place.

1701847.title: True Love
1701847.overview: Elliot wants to reconnect with his ex-boyfriend, Will, but a dark turn reveals the true nature of their relationship.

1705111.title: Paper Heart
1705111.overview: Having despaired after the painful death of a close friend, Ayan is set to perform at a farewell gathering, which helps him sort out their relationship and understand what she truly meant to him — a friend or a lover.

1707479.title: Butcher: Invisible Wounds
1707479.overview: A major feature-length ITV documentary about footballer Terry Butcher will chart his career as well as the devastating personal tragedy of the loss of his Army veteran son.  Butcher is one of England's most celebrated players, with 77 caps, seven times as captain. Photos and footage of him playing on with a bandage around a head injury during a vital World Cup qualifier provide one of the iconic images of the national team's history. Butcher's achievements in the club game include trophy-winning stints at Ipswich Town and Glasgow Rangers.  But Butcher: Invisible Wounds also tells the story of the personal loss he endured following the death of his son Chris, a British Army veteran who passed away after suffering severe PTSD.

1707735.title: Be Hippie – Made in Poland
1707735.overview: What does it mean to be a “HIPPIE”?  In the road movie ”Be Hippie – Made in Poland“, Ronald and Tomek set out in search of Poland’s last remaining hippies and explore what defines the essence of a hippie.  The ideals and ideas of that era reflect a hopeful and mindful approach to people and nature.
1707735.trailerName: BE HIPPIE Made in Poland (Trailer german)

1708567.title: Minnesota Mao
1708567.overview: A cutting look at the strange connections between Governor Tim Walz—aka "Minnesota Mao"—and Chairman Mao Zedong, the former dictator of the Chinese Communist Party, based on interviews, archival footage, and news and social media.

1708823.title: Ramón Vázquez
1708823.overview: His name is Ramón Vázquez. He comes from La Pampa and wants to reach Soto, near Córdoba, to reunite with his father. He has not seen him in thirty years. The difficult journey gives rise to a series of encounters on the threshold. And the light blinds.

1708951.title: The Friend's House is Here
1708951.overview: Pari and Hanna, roommates and friends, live in modern-day Tehran. Pari is a curator and director of an independent theatre group; Hanna is a dancer, who wants to get out of Iran as soon as possible. The situation of both women becomes more complicated, but their friendship is strong in the face of political oppression. The Friend’s House is Here is a rewarding cinematic experience, conveying a sense of freedom and hope, even though it originated under the exact opposite conditions. Just a few days after the June War in Iran, the crew, headed by directing duo Hossein Keshavarz and Maryam Ataei, took to the streets of Tehran to make a film about a generation that no longer wants to live according to imposed rules and is striving to achieve one of the fundamental human rights, the right to freedom of artistic expression.

1710999.title: Detached
1710999.overview: Flor and his best friend Otis have always done everything together, but when a conversation reveals that their bond means different things to each of them, Flor is forced to confront a friendship he thought was unbreakable.

1711127.title: Words From The Void
1711127.overview: A young man has to grapple with an intense moral dilemma.

1711447.title: Little Poems in Prose
1711447.overview: An anthology of black humour by Radu Jude and Andrei Rus, revealing the inexhaustibly grotesque energy of TikTok (including in the age of the deepfake).

1711959.title: Cheer Dad
1711959.overview: When a young girl and her family move to a new town, she yearns for a sense of belonging. She finds it by joining her school's cheerleading squad. Inspired by her new found love and dedication to the sport, her adoptive father comes out for support and is soon recruited as the assistant coach. As the father and daughter grow together, they'll see if they have what it takes to win the championship.

1712087.title: Absolution
1712087.overview: A character driven short drama about grief and survivors guilt set in Las Vegas.

1712471.title: Light 3
1712471.overview: A revenge short made for the 48 hour film project Brisbane.

1713175.title: Shikar

As Parimita digs deeper into the case, hidden secrets and unexpected suspects begin to emerge. Every clue reveals a new layer of deception, turning the investigation into a dangerous maze of lies, betrayal, and mystery. With the truth becoming harder to uncover, Parimita must risk everything to expose the real culprit before she herself becomes trapped in the deadly conspiracy.

1713367.title: Hell Grind
1713367.overview: The film follows four street thieves. After a botched heist, one of them is transported into an underworld. The others team up with a secret military group and battle demon hordes to save her.

1713495.title: Voicemail

A conversation happens between voicemail audio from the artist’s late mother and a transcription of his silent responses in the subtitles. 1714135.title: The Seeds We Carry
1714135.overview: A short documentary weaving intimate portraits of community farm stewards in Southwest Philadelphia. Through the rhythms of planting, cooking and sharing food, the protagonists reveal how everyday acts of care and resistance nurture belonging, foster cross-cultural kinship and preserve a sense of home amid the pressures of gentrification and displacement.

1715543.title: A Sense of Dread
1715543.overview: Four men working at a remote scientific outpost unravel the disturbing secrets about the facility's history, signaling the approach of a mysterious menace that will not only consume these men, but, perhaps, everyone on the planet.

1717079.title: Loose ends

After her grandmother passes Sersha finds herself alone and struck with intense grief, fighting with her family and struggling with her everyday life. Amongst her struggles she finds herself haunted by a banshee unable to escape its grasps.

1729175.title: Pirjo in Sweden
1729175.overview: When Pirjo Heikkilä embarrasses herself in public at a charity event, she begins to believe that she needs a change of scenery. 1731351.overview: Louis and Lénore have sought refuge in a lonely house by the sea. As in a dream, zombies appear, wandering at nightfall. Do they really exist?

1737687.overview: Andrea, her daughter Alex and her fish are moving out of the city. Andrea wants to brings them together despite the tensions, Alex does not speak, the fish is a bother and nobody really want to move out.

1739095.overview: An aspiring home cook strives to craft the perfect omelette for his partner in this passionate food film.

1739735.title: James McNeill Whistler

This blockbuster exhibition promises to reawaken the world to just how important Whistler is to art history, uniting world-famous masterpieces with rarely seen works. Exhibition on Screen will bring these stunning works and the incredible story behind them to cinemas around the world while the exhibition is still running, bringing this truly global artist to a global audience. This will be an unmissable chance to get to know this visually spectacular artist and the influence he has had on those who followed.
1739735.trailerName: JAMES McNEILL WHISTLER | OFFICIAL TRAILER | EXHIBITION ON SCREEN

1739799.title: War of the Worlds
1739799.overview: Collage film built upon the audio of The War of the Worlds, directed and narrated by Orson Welles. Originally broadcast in October 1938 as a Halloween prank, the program famously triggered mass panic across the United States, as its format—presented as a series of live news bulletins—proved uncannily convincing. Absorbing the visual language of the contemporary media environment, W:A:R:O:F:T:H:E:W:O:R:L:D:S constructs a peculiar media-archaeological artifact. AI-generated videos, drone footage, feature films, video games, and online fragments converge with the original radio broadcast, creating a layered and unstable field of perception.

1741207.title: Curse of the Shark
1741207.overview: When a marine biology team explore unusual shark activity in Central America, they discover the horrifying truth behind an island legend.

1742807.title: Something Good Going On
1742807.overview: A Chinese-Indonesian teen confronts a stolen restaurant paycheck, a strained father-son bond, and the cost of his Ivy League future.

1744151.title: Three Housewives and a Body
1744151.overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

1745879.title: Unsettled Soil
1745879.overview: When three couples come together for an amazing chance to be in a reality show will quickly realize that this will not be anything they will forget.

1747479.overview: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

1748567.overview: In the near future, a pregnant woman faces an impossible choice in a world gone to ruin.

1748823.overview: The final movie of the trilogy will explore the connections with the Huntrix where they travel to New York for a getaway from the Idol Awards incident. It turns out that the 3 girls and Lewis being sunk into the Korean demon cube which is a portal vortex that sent the 3 girls to Mushroom Kingdom and Lewis was sent to Green Hill where it became under hidden earth where the reality isn't connected.

1748951.title: Breaking the Cycle
1748951.overview: Ken, a Christian conservative, and Rowan, a tree-hugging skeptic, bike from Santa Monica to D.C. before Congress breaks—raising money for shelters and demanding a standard: a safe bed for anyone who needs it. Their odd-couple chemistry fuels a documentary that's part comedy, part gut-punch, meeting the homelessness crisis face-to-face and proving unlikely partners can unite to change the world.

1749591.title: Smell The Flowers
1749591.overview: Man goes to work then comes home again.

As he’s thrusted into the insane world of verticals, Milo navigates their absurdity with the question: is the chaos worth the pursuit of his lifelong dream?

1754071.title: Route 66: The Main Street of America
1754071.overview: Route 66: The Main Street of America is a centennial celebration of this legendary highway. It’s a powerfully moving feature-length documentary that travels the route, sharing unforgettable stories along the way. From unexpected roadside attractions to revitalized main streets, each encounter reveals communities finding new life and purpose—making new history—proving the most meaningful journeys often unfold on the road less traveled.
1754071.original_title: Route 66: The Main Street of America

1754199.title: Striking Matches
1754199.overview: Mellow is drifting through life without a purpose still trying to connect with the world around her while something darker is lurking beneath the surface.

1754839.title: ASAP Rocky – the assault in Stockholm
1754839.overview: Global superstar A$AP Rocky was arrested following an assault in Stockholm in 2019. It became a major international news story. Here, those who were there recount what actually happened.

1755735.title: ASABIYYA
1755735.overview: The historic protests against the University of Texas' complicity in funding the genocide in Gaza on April 24, 2024 made international news after university administration deployed state troopers on peaceful protestors. Ammer Qaddumi, the first to be arrested that day, must navigate a suspension from the school, his lawsuit against the university and continuing activism while he remains off campus. ASABIYYA [solidarity] follows the relationship between Ammer and his sister Lamar in the year after the major protests and their continued local activism despite limitations, long after news cameras have turned away.

1756823.title: A note on the ruins for visitors
1756823.overview: A note on the ruins for visitors is a deeply personal portrait of the Assyrian community from fragments of material drawn from Bahto’s family history, ancient artifacts, and collaborations with contemporary artists working across the diaspora. “When Daesh invaded Iraq and released videos of themselves destroying ancient Assyrian artworks in the Mosul Museum,” Bahto explains, “I found myself thinking more deeply about my relationship to history as the grandchild of survivors of Seyfo – the Assyrian genocide. In fact, I realized that the genocide hadn’t ended.” The film investigates the materiality of cultural memory alongside its personal and spiritual dimensions, embodying the rebuilding of a community and connection to culture that honors the past while insisting on an open future.

1756951.title: I nisidiani
